svg.title: Bec4096 framing of one body
svg.desc: Positions 29, 300, 301 and 4095 with external population 4. Block populations are 1, 2, thirteen zeros, then 1. Four split levels of the 4096-position tree recover them; only regions that are neither empty nor full store a field. The body is a 16-bit raw mask (zero: no block is stored raw), twelve head bits, one length-table bit (block 1), then the Bec256 streams of blocks 0, 1 and 15, 8, 15 and 8 bits, packed bit by bit, and four padding bits: eight bytes 00 00 db e2 54 11 07 0e. Binding decodes a directory of each block's population and stream start bit. Blocks whose stream would exceed 256 bits are stored raw: mask bit set, 32 plain bytes after the mask, counted as empty in the head.

g.text: Bec4096: one headless body for sixteen blocks
blocks 2–14 empty: no stream, no length
(population 1 needs none; block 15's is never stored)
decoded once by bind_reader; every block access starts here
Blocks whose stream would exceed 256 bits are stored raw: their mask bits are set,
their 32 plain bytes follow the mask in block order, and the head counts them as empty.
